articles.title: A simple daily fiber supplement reduced arthritis pain and improved strength
articles.summary: A new clinical trial suggests that a simple daily fiber supplement could significantly reduce knee osteoarthritis pain, improve muscle strength, and make the body less sensitive to pain. Researchers discovered that the benefits may be linked to changes in gut bacteria and the hormone GLP-1, revealing a promising new approach to arthritis relief.

articles.title: Entertainment Hits $332.B To Become World’s Second Most Valuable Sector As Netflix, YouTube & Spotify Fly – Interbrand Report
articles.summary: Hollywood is struggling with layoffs and budget cuts, but entertainment just overtook the automotive industry to become the world’s second-largest business sector. That’s according to consultancy Interbrand, whose latest Best Global Brands report pegs the cumulative value of entertainment companies at $332.5B, an increase of 12.4% year-on-year.
